description: The studio's decisions layered over docs/research/evidence-register.json when scripts/registry/sync.py regenerates contracts/registry/components.v1.json. Every entry cites the ADR or document it comes from. Edit this file (or the evidence register), never components.v1.json.

lane_rules.research_includes_individual: ADR-0011 rule 5: research is the private-experiments lane, so every component allowed in individual is also allowed in research.

swiftf0.source: ADR-0011 rule 6 and architecture.md §10: individual and research until its provenance review (MIT-labelled ONNX trained on CC BY-NC-SA data).

melband-roformer-kim.source: ADR-0006, ADR-0011 rule 6, the spec's Unverified capabilities table and the LLC-separator ticket: MIT code and weights, but its training data is UNVERIFIED, so llc waits for the training-data review; a passing review widens this row by contract-fix PR.

basic-pitch.source: ADR-0011 rule 6 (design review 2026-10-09): Apache-2.0, but trained partly on singing and piano datasets whose terms are unchecked (the register's own note cites iKala); individual and research until the provenance review ticket records its training datasets and their terms.

muq.source: O-06: non-commercial scorers are allowed in individual and research projects (diagnostics only, ADR-0005).

songeval.source: O-06: non-commercial scorers are allowed in individual and research projects (diagnostics only, ADR-0005).

cmi-rm-tunejury.source: O-06: non-commercial scorers are allowed in individual and research projects (diagnostics only, ADR-0005).

mir-eval.source: lanes.v1.json: individual and llc forbid an unverified license; widened when its license row is verified (T03).

g2p-phonemizer.source: lanes.v1.json: individual and llc forbid an unverified license; widened when the lyric-error-rate ticket verifies the G2P.

midi-synth-soundfont.source: lanes.v1.json: individual and llc forbid an unverified license; widened by the MIDI synth evaluation ticket.

supplement.source: Components on the v1 path that the evidence register has no row for: the studio's own code and the stack libraries whose licenses RECONCILIATION.md §8 lists as never checked. Their licenses are recorded as UNVERIFIED, not assumed.

rows.name: NeutralVoice (the studio's own deterministic guide voice)
rows.role: Renders the assembled melody as a plain sung guide: R2-synth input, ground-truth fixtures, FakeEngine's sound, the Playwright fake mic (ADR-0032).
rows.code_license: Own code (all rights reserved until Q5)
rows.redistribution_blocker: None (own code; its license is owner-pending, Q5).
rows.notes: Not built yet. Its quality as a cover input is unmeasured (architecture.md §12).

rows.name: The studio's control service, worker SDK, analysis worker and FakeEngine code
rows.role: Everything the studio writes itself: Score, the HMM note segmentation, the true-peak meter, assembly, export.
rows.code_license: Own code (all rights reserved until Q5)
rows.redistribution_blocker: None (own code; its license is owner-pending, Q5).

rows.name: mido (MIDI import and export in Score)
